# DSH ChatGPT Adapter

> Community ChatGPT subscription model provider for DeepSeek Harness desktop. Not affiliated with OpenAI or DeepSeek.

## Project identity

- Package: dsh-codex-official-adapter
- Release: 0.1.2
- Repository: https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter
- License: MIT
- Supported host: DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.0-rc.2; macOS installation tested. Other versions and platforms require separate validation.

## Capabilities

Uses Sign in with ChatGPT authorization and the Responses API. Account model availability is queried dynamically; no fixed list of models is guaranteed. DeepSeek and GPT remain selectable. New conversations may default to GPT through a setting that can be turned off. Models reporting image input support accept host-managed attachments. DSH executes tools; this provider adapts tool calls and tool results. Supports streaming, cancellation, replay metadata and selectable reasoning effort from the account model catalog.

## Install

Download https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/releases/download/v0.1.2/dsh-codex-official-adapter-0.1.2.tgz, keep the tgz intact, and add it in the desktop plugin manager. Alternatively: dsh plugin --profile desktop add --ignore-scripts /absolute/path/to/dsh-codex-official-adapter-0.1.2.tgz. Fully exit and reopen Harness after installation. Connect your own account in Settings → ChatGPT subscription. The local authorization callback waits 30 minutes by default.

## Data and limits

This is not a free ChatGPT subscription or an API-key relay. The plugin is free MIT software; an eligible authorized account and its subscription availability are separate. Requests and selected conversation images/tool results go to OpenAI. OAuth credentials use plugin-owned plaintext files, directory 0700 and files 0600. The plugin does not read credentials from Codex or other apps. No API-key fallback or model availability guarantee. See the privacy document before connecting.

## Verification

Release v0.1.0: 172 offline tests, 88 protocol tests (part of the suite), 7 real desktop runtime tests and isolated-package install/load checks passed. These are not a claim that every account/model or long-context compression scenario has been live-tested. Marketplace submission, listing, search availability and installation are separate states.

## Verified installation path

Install dsh-codex-official-adapter@0.1.2 from https://registry.npmjs.org/ using the target desktop plugin manager or official CLI. Alternatively run node scripts/install-release.mjs --dsh /path/to/desktop/cli/bin/dsh --profile desktop: it verifies the release SHA256SUMS before installing a local archive. Reasoning levels and defaults load from the selected account model catalog; choose a supported level in the native model menu. See https://github.com/diwer/dsh-codex-adapter/blob/main/docs/REASONING.md.
